Seiko · ref. SRPH55 / SRPH57 / SRPH59

King Turtle

Dive · 44–45mm · 200m · automatic

The King Turtle is a premium version of Seiko's iconic cushion-cased "Turtle" dive watch. It is defined by its robust build and upgraded materials, such as a sapphire crystal and a ceramic bezel insert, which distinguish it from the standard Turtle models.

The story

The story of the Turtle begins in 1976 with the release of the 6306 and 6309 references, which gained a following for their distinctive cushion-shaped cases. After production ceased in the 1980s, Seiko reintroduced the Turtle design in 2015 under its Prospex line. In late 2019, the "King Turtle" was introduced as an evolution of this design, incorporating more premium materials like sapphire crystals and ceramic bezels, and often featuring textured dials. This modern iteration elevates the classic tool watch with contemporary specifications while retaining the beloved case shape.
